canDoYue: 你識講預算同草圖、比較白K金同黃K金，仲識問一半訂金同四個星期。
canDoEn: Talk about a budget and a sketch, compare white gold with yellow gold, and ask about a half deposit.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: We have a clear budget for a custom ring this month, and I brought a first sketch of the stone.
dialogue.glossYue: 我哋今個月有個清楚預算訂造戒指，我帶咗第一張石草圖。
dialogue.say: We have a clear budget for a custom ring this month, and I brought a first sketch of the stone.

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: This first sketch shows a low setting, and the round shape sits close to the finger.
dialogue.glossYue: 呢張草圖係低鑲，圓形貼住手指。
dialogue.say: This first sketch shows a low setting, and the round shape sits close to the finger.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: Could we use white gold for the band, or is yellow gold a better choice for this stone?
dialogue.glossYue: 戒圈用白K金，定係黃K金更適合呢粒石？
dialogue.say: Could we use white gold for the band, or is yellow gold a better choice for this stone?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: Yellow gold suits this stone because the warm colour matches the gem better than a pale metal.
dialogue.glossYue: 黃K金適合呢粒石，因為暖色比淺色金屬襯呢粒石。
dialogue.say: Yellow gold suits this stone because the warm colour matches the gem better than a pale metal.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: How long will the ring take, and what deposit do you need from us for this work?
dialogue.glossYue: 戒指要幾耐，訂金要幾多？
dialogue.say: How long will the ring take, and what deposit do you need from us for this work?

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: The ring takes four weeks, and the deposit is half the budget once you confirm the sketch.
dialogue.glossYue: 戒指要四個星期，你確認草圖之後，訂金係預算一半。
dialogue.say: The ring takes four weeks, and the deposit is half the budget once you confirm the sketch.

dialogue.speaker: gus
dialogue.text: I can place the half deposit this week, and I will wait for the finished ring.
dialogue.glossYue: 我呢個星期可以落一半訂金，然後等隻戒指做好。
dialogue.say: I can place the half deposit this week, and I will wait for the finished ring.

dialogue.speaker: ida
dialogue.text: I will hold the ring once the half deposit arrives, and you can pick it up in four weeks.
dialogue.glossYue: 一半訂金到咗我就留住隻戒指，四個星期後你可以嚟取。
dialogue.say: I will hold the ring once the half deposit arrives, and you can pick it up in four weeks.
